Name: Magic Furniture
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
Are you too lazy to ride your horse sometimes to go places, let alone walk there? Do you wish you could just teleport everywhere? This mod is for you!


[size=5]What This Mod Does[/size]
This mod adds four new furniture items that all allow you to teleport somewhere convenient. The items are sold at different shops around the valley, and there are also some letters that give you a little more context to the items. If you want to find about them naturally, don't look at the images tab! 

For details on the items:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Magic Archway: sold by the Dwarf. Takes you to the Train Station.
[*]Magic Tree: sold by Sandy. Takes you to the tree next to the community center.
[*]Magic Carpet: sold by the Traveling Merchant in the winter. Takes you to near the Traveling Merchant's cart location.
[*]Magic Statue: sold by Krobus. Takes you to the sewer.
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=5]How to Configure This Mod[/size]
New in the 1.0.1 update, the configuration options allow you to change how much each item costs, as well as whether or not the two animated items are animated. You can either use GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu) or edit the config.json directly. The allowable values for each price is from 0 to 1,000,000. 

New in the 1.0.2 update, you can also choose whether or not to sell the magic furniture in the furniture catalogue. By default, it will be disabled. 

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
This mod has not been tested with all possible other mods, so let me know if you run into any issues! In particular, if you use any mods that change the dimensions of the town map, forest map, or railroad map, you may end up somewhere odd. Users report it is compatible with ﻿SVE, Kid's Treehouse, and A Cleaner Sewer mods.
